newsitem.title: USA: MOTOR RACING-EDDIE CHEEVER WINS IRL RACE.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-EDDIE CHEEVER WINS IRL RACE.

text.p: Cheever, who went 19 years without a victory in Formula One,
IndyCar or Indy Racing League, won the rain-shortened Walt
Disney World 200 IRL race on Saturday.
Cheever, 39, won after polesitter Tony Stewart, who
dominated the race, spun in his own oil on lap 146.
Driving a G Force Oldsmobile, Cheever averaged 133.995 mph
(215.638 kph) in the race, which was stopped after the 149th
Mike Groff of the United States, the current series points
leader, finished second in a G Force Infiniti. Canadian Scott
Goodyear was third in a G Force Oldsmobile.
American driver Davy Jones remained in serious condition
at Orlando Regional Medical Centre after suffering neck
injuries in a crash during practice on Thursday.
